WORKFLOW
PATTERN: Run tests via Xcode Product → Test (Cmd+U), NOT via xcodebuild test in terminal
WHEN: Any time tests need to be run
WHY: `xcodebuild test` spawns multiple simulator instances simultaneously, causing crashes and chaos. Ned explicitly raged about this — 'fucking simulators spawning non stop'
ALTERNATIVE: `xcodebuild build-for-testing` is safe (just compiles). Only `test` and `test-without-building` spawn simulators.
